title: Blobfish - Hypixel Skyblock
description: Modpack for Hypixel Skyblock. Preconfigured, so you don't have to do any more tinkering.
body:
This is a modpack specifically made for Hypixel Skyblock. It offers features mainly from Skyhanni and Skyblocker, some optimisation mods for a smoother experience and a few quality of life mods.

The modpack will not overwhelm you with a crazy amount of information on the screen, but rather shows the most important things. It also includes optional resource packs if you don't enjoy the vanilla look.

The vision is to offer a good skyblock experience without the need to tinker, as it can get quite complicated and annoying.

If you intend to use the resource packs included in this modpack (specifically Hypixel Plus), I recommend putting "-Xss4M" into the custom Java arguments which can be found in the settings under Java and memory.
